# `ExportImage`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Progress of copying or moving saved images between storage volumes.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, NotifyExportProgress @0x127810, export worker @0x13b470 (64-bit build) |

Custom progress producer NotifyExportProgress, called by the export worker at start, on progress and at the end. Always writes state, lapse, total, keep and dst_storage; no lapse_ms, route, code or error. Units of lapse/total are caller-specific counts. No timer cap. Recipients: all retained 4700 sockets. No reply-before-event order is established: the RPC reply that starts the worker and the worker's events can arrive in either order. No fixed cadence. get_app_state reports the same counts under different names. The APK defines the name only; no app event branch is established.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"ExportImage"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Caller-supplied stage. The export worker passes start, frame_complete and complete; complete is also sent after a requested stop, so it does not prove every copy succeeded. One of: `start`, `frame_complete`, `complete`. [READ] |
| `lapse` | integer | yes | - | Completed units (files or frames); not a duration. [READ] |
| `total` | integer | yes | - | Total units. [READ] |
| `keep` | boolean | yes | - | Keep-source option (false allows removing each source after copying). [READ] |
| `dst_storage` | string | yes | - | Destination storage type. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, progress - Progress (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"ExportImage","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"frame_complete","lapse":7,"total":20,"keep":true,"dst_storage":"udisk"}
```
